method.tracking: Connected occupied 1 km cells: at most 3 km between cell centers and two UTC days; separate sensors; single reports retained.
method.occurrence: Year-balanced seasonal fraction of empty comparison windows. First recorded regional events retain score 100, regardless of support or regional pooling.
method.activity: Conditional positive-count rank against the largest single historical event in the same 10 km comparison area and same measurement duration.
method.regional_support: Only activity strength borrows from four equally sized comparison areas 30 km away when fewer than three local active years exist. Weight=(3-active years)/3; no occurrence pooling.
method.novelty: No earlier retained observation from another inferred event inside the same 10 km area, in the selected sensor archive. This does not establish absence of pre-archive fires.
method.exclusion: Whole target measurement years and every reference window overlapping the same inferred event are excluded.
method.outlier: Either occurrence or activity exceeds the threshold; component scores and reasons remain separate. This is not a calibrated combined probability.
method.support: Reference support and seasonal-window sensitivity describe reliability without reducing novelty or suppressing first recorded events.
